nina: FYI I ran into a weird parity issue trying to wire the new onboarding flow to the Python SDK embeddings + rerank paths.
nina: The sample app's batcher assumes embeddings() -> List[List[float]] but when you call embeddings with a single string the client returns a flat vector. Also noticed rerank.async returns objects with 'ranked' whereas rerank.sync returns 'scores'.
marc: Can you paste the exact shapes you saw?
nina: Sure. Sync embeddings (unexpected):
```json
{"model":"redwood-embedding-1","embedding":[0.1,0.2,-0.03]}
```

nina: REST (and doc) shape we want: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-embedding-1","embedding":[[0.1,0.2,-0.03]]}
```

tiago: For rerank I saw async return: 
```json
{"ranked":[{"doc_id":"b","score":0.6},{"doc_id":"a","score":0.4}]}
```

tiago: Sync rerank returned: 
```json
{"scores":[0.6,0.4],"order":["b","a"]}
```

leo: Sounds like two separate issues: 1) embeddings singleton collapse; 2) rerank mapping differences (field names + nesting). Both likely in post-processors.
marc: We also got a bug report: the async client loses the Authorization header when used with our retry middleware on long-running requests. That could explain some users seeing different responses if they hit auth fallbacks.
nina: Good catch. For me it was definitely local with no auth changes, but that retry strip is worth checking.
tiago: I'll add a test matrix: sync vs async for embeddings single-input, batched inputs, and rerank outputs. Also test with our retry middleware that preserves headers across retries.
leo: Proposed fixes: - EmbeddingsClient.return_strict_list_of_vectors() behavior: always wrap singletons. - RerankClient.normalize() to emit canonical {"scores": [...], "doc_ids": [...]}. - Add BatchHelpers.batch_inputs() to centralize batching and keep typing consistent.
marc: Typing request: create TypedDicts/dataclasses in sdk/types/embeddings.py and sdk/types/rerank.py. Current stubs are Any and make mypy useless.
tiago: I'll prototype dataclasses: EmbeddingResponse(vectors: List[List[float]], model: str) and RerankResponse(scores: List[float], doc_ids: List[str]).
ci-bot: CI queued: tests/embedding_parity.py and tests/rerank_parity.py on 1718814500.
marc: Also we should add a tiny compatibility shim that logs a deprecation warning if a flat vector is returned. Avoid surprising downstream apps during the release.
leo: Yes, deprecation warning for one minor release, then enforce. Update CHANGELOG/UPGRADING.md.
tiago: I'll open a PR that: 1) adds BatchHelpers.normalize_embeddings, 2) canonical rerank normalizer, 3) typed dataclasses, 4) tests for sync vs async vs middleware.
marc: Ping me when draft is up. Also include an example snippet in examples/semantic_search showing usage with the new BatchHelpers so onboarding renders correctly.
ci-bot: Build status: lint failed on new types file at 1718814799 0/25 errors. See https://ci.internal/12345
nina: Thanks. I'll iterate on types to satisfy lint. If we can get the patch in tomorrow AM we'll unblock the onboarding cohort.
marc: One last note: check our Java/JS SDKs too for parity; we should avoid drifting across languages. Maybe add a small cross-sdk parity test harness in infra.
leo: Agreed. Filing infra task after this PR.
